info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Systems Operation Status-spec
info.description: The System Operations Status Retrieval API enables users to access the current operational status of various banking systems. This API serves as a vital tool for IT management teams to monitor system health and performance. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve up-to-date information about system operations, aiding in proactive maintenance and incident management. Typical consumers of this API include IT operations personnel and system administrators who require visibility into system functionality and uptime.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of systems operations
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest status of all systems operations within the IT management framework. It provides insights into system performance, uptime, and any issues that may require attention.

requestBody.description: Request body containing criteria to retrieve the status of systems operations. Ensure the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status of systems operations.

ListSystemsOperationStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations status in the IT Management Systems. It is expected to contain a string.

systemId.description: The unique identifier for the system.

environment.description: The environment in which the system is deployed (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: Identifier for the change associated with the current operation status.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the system.

plannedAt.description: Timestamp of when the operation is planned.

serviceTier.description: The service tier assigned to the system.

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target availability percentage for the system.

maintenanceWindow.description: Time interval during which maintenance is scheduled.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the record (e.g., active, archived).

version.description: The version of the system configuration.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update made to the system status.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.

ListSystemsOperationStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for the status of systems operations. Contains information about the system configuration and operational metrics.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate the request and response.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Metadata object containing additional information about the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint being accessed. This ID can be used for tracking the specific endpoint's performance and behavior.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that executed the operation. This helps identify which application instance handled the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. Clients must include a valid JWT (JSON Web Token) in the Authorization header to access secured endpoints.
